title: uSurvive
description: uSurvive reimagines what Minecraft could've been if Mojang had taken a slightly different path - one that enhances the base game while staying true to its core and keeping a focus on multiplayer.
body:
uSurvive reimagines what Minecraft could've been if Mojang had taken a slightly different path - one that enhances the base game while staying true to its core and keeping a focus on multiplayer. Whether you're into building, combat, or exploration, there's something here for you!

We have features like Claims, Backpacks, Auctions, QuickShops, Quests, Custom Items/Mobs, and much more!

**Key Highlights:**
## 🏡 Custom Claiming System
- Protect your builds in the overworld and focus on creativity, not griefing. No more finicky "golden claim shovel"!

## ⚔️ Custom Abyss Dimension
- Explore a toxic fungi wasteland filled with unique foes, capture dangerous outposts, and battle for powerful loot.

## 🌍 Evolved Survival Experience
- Discover a universe that expands what survival can be: richer exploration, meaningful combat, and absolute multiplayer fun.

The server will always attempt to update to the latest version of Minecraft as soon as possible. We're opening the gates early to build the server with the community. Tons of features are in the works- your feedback will help shape the direction of uSurvive! We listen to YOUR ideas!
